about.en: The Nasdaq-100 Index (NDX) is a modified market-capitalization-weighted index of the 100 largest non-financial companies listed on the Nasdaq Stock Market, published by Nasdaq. Crypto venues list perpetuals on it under tickers such as NAS100 or US100. NDX is an index reference, not a token, fund share or redeemable basket; funds tracking it, such as Invesco QQQ, are separate assets.
